requirements.name: Represent every selected scenario

scenarios.name: Multiple cases in a requirement
scenarios.text:
#### Scenario: Multiple cases in a requirement
- **WHEN** a requirement contains several scenarios
- **THEN** logically related scenarios share condition or decision nodes with labeled branches
- **AND** each scenario retains its preconditions, full result and traced graph path
- **AND** unrelated or ambiguously overlapping cases remain separate without an invented execution order or priority

scenarios.name: Positive and negative cases
scenarios.text:
#### Scenario: Positive and negative cases
- **WHEN** two scenarios describe positive and negative cases of the same logical check
- **THEN** the graph represents that check once with its corresponding branches
- **AND** any additional precondition is preserved as a guard on the appropriate branch

scenarios.name: Shared graph introduces extra routes
scenarios.text:
#### Scenario: Shared graph introduces extra routes
- **WHEN** joining and splitting shared nodes creates a root-to-result route absent from the declared source-scenario paths
- **THEN** rendering reports the unsupported route before writing diagrams

scenarios.name: Changed requirement
scenarios.text:
#### Scenario: Changed requirement
- **WHEN** a selected delta modifies a current requirement
- **THEN** the proposed view includes its complete effective scenario set
- **AND** current diagrams remain unchanged until canonical specs actually change

scenarios.name: Incomplete coverage
scenarios.text:
#### Scenario: Incomplete coverage
- **WHEN** a rendering model omits a selected scenario or invents another
- **THEN** the renderer reports the coverage error before writing diagrams

requirements.text:
### Requirement: Represent every selected scenario
The suite SHALL conceptualize the effective scenarios of selected specs as Mermaid graphs, sharing logically related conditions, decisions and equivalent results while preserving a trace to every source scenario.

#### Scenario: Multiple cases in a requirement
- **WHEN** a requirement contains several scenarios
- **THEN** logically related scenarios share condition or decision nodes with labeled branches
- **AND** each scenario retains its preconditions, full result and traced graph path
- **AND** unrelated or ambiguously overlapping cases remain separate without an invented execution order or priority

#### Scenario: Positive and negative cases
- **WHEN** two scenarios describe positive and negative cases of the same logical check
- **THEN** the graph represents that check once with its corresponding branches
- **AND** any additional precondition is preserved as a guard on the appropriate branch

#### Scenario: Shared graph introduces extra routes
- **WHEN** joining and splitting shared nodes creates a root-to-result route absent from the declared source-scenario paths
- **THEN** rendering reports the unsupported route before writing diagrams

#### Scenario: Changed requirement
- **WHEN** a selected delta modifies a current requirement
- **THEN** the proposed view includes its complete effective scenario set
- **AND** current diagrams remain unchanged until canonical specs actually change

#### Scenario: Incomplete coverage
- **WHEN** a rendering model omits a selected scenario or invents another
- **THEN** the renderer reports the coverage error before writing diagrams

requirements.name: Show evidenced capability relationships

scenarios.name: Inferred association
scenarios.text:
#### Scenario: Inferred association
- **WHEN** an agent interprets an association without an explicit dependency contract
- **THEN** it may show a dotted related-to connection with its source evidence
- **AND** it does not show an inferred typed dependency

requirements.text:
### Requirement: Show evidenced capability relationships
The map SHALL show relationships with source evidence and distinguish inferred associations from explicitly documented dependencies.

#### Scenario: Inferred association
- **WHEN** an agent interprets an association without an explicit dependency contract
- **THEN** it may show a dotted related-to connection with its source evidence
- **AND** it does not show an inferred typed dependency

requirements.name: Preserve source and output ownership

scenarios.name: Source changed during generation
scenarios.text:
#### Scenario: Source changed during generation
- **WHEN** specs change after the generation snapshot
- **THEN** rendering stops and requests a fresh snapshot

scenarios.name: Hand-edited drawing
scenarios.text:
#### Scenario: Hand-edited drawing
- **WHEN** a generated diagram was manually modified
- **THEN** regeneration preserves it and reports the conflict

scenarios.name: Archived proposal
scenarios.text:
#### Scenario: Archived proposal
- **WHEN** OpenSpec moves a change with generated views to its archive
- **THEN** the suite rebases the source links and retains a historical preview
- **AND** historical checks compare the archived delta and outputs without requiring today's base specs to match

requirements.text:
### Requirement: Preserve source and output ownership
Rendering SHALL leave specs unchanged, replace only its own unedited outputs and detect stale views from source content or inventory changes.

#### Scenario: Source changed during generation
- **WHEN** specs change after the generation snapshot
- **THEN** rendering stops and requests a fresh snapshot

#### Scenario: Hand-edited drawing
- **WHEN** a generated diagram was manually modified
- **THEN** regeneration preserves it and reports the conflict

#### Scenario: Archived proposal
- **WHEN** OpenSpec moves a change with generated views to its archive
- **THEN** the suite rebases the source links and retains a historical preview
- **AND** historical checks compare the archived delta and outputs without requiring today's base specs to match

requirements.name: Compose the original operation

scenarios.name: Planning writes specifications
scenarios.text:
#### Scenario: Planning writes specifications
- **WHEN** the original planning operation writes spec artifacts
- **THEN** the wrapper generates their proposed views through readable-diagrams
- **AND** it stops before implementation

scenarios.name: Original skill is unavailable
scenarios.text:
#### Scenario: Original skill is unavailable
- **WHEN** a requested wrapper cannot find its original skill
- **THEN** it reports the missing dependency without reconstructing the workflow

scenarios.name: Read-only operation
scenarios.text:
#### Scenario: Read-only operation
- **WHEN** the user explores or verifies without requesting persistent capture
- **THEN** the wrapper reads or checks views without writing diagrams

requirements.text:
### Requirement: Compose the original operation
The suite SHALL provide a distinct skill entry point for each supported installed OpenSpec operation and follow the actual original skill with the same change, schema, selected store and stopping conditions.

#### Scenario: Planning writes specifications
- **WHEN** the original planning operation writes spec artifacts
- **THEN** the wrapper generates their proposed views through readable-diagrams
- **AND** it stops before implementation

#### Scenario: Original skill is unavailable
- **WHEN** a requested wrapper cannot find its original skill
- **THEN** it reports the missing dependency without reconstructing the workflow

#### Scenario: Read-only operation
- **WHEN** the user explores or verifies without requesting persistent capture
- **THEN** the wrapper reads or checks views without writing diagrams

requirements.name: Install alongside existing skills

scenarios.name: Core profile
scenarios.text:
#### Scenario: Core profile
- **WHEN** six core OpenSpec operations are installed
- **THEN** Chart installs their six wrappers and one shared diagram skill

scenarios.name: Modified installation
scenarios.text:
#### Scenario: Modified installation
- **WHEN** a Chart skill differs from its managed installation receipt
- **THEN** an update reports the conflict and preserves the edited file

requirements.text:
### Requirement: Install alongside existing skills
The installer SHALL add self-contained Chart skills only for installed originals and preserve original skills, project configuration and local skill edits.

#### Scenario: Core profile
- **WHEN** six core OpenSpec operations are installed
- **THEN** Chart installs their six wrappers and one shared diagram skill

#### Scenario: Modified installation
- **WHEN** a Chart skill differs from its managed installation receipt
- **THEN** an update reports the conflict and preserves the edited file

requirements.name: Respect current and historical scope

scenarios.name: Archive without synchronization
scenarios.text:
#### Scenario: Archive without synchronization
- **WHEN** the original operation archives a change without syncing its specs
- **THEN** the proposed view remains historical in the archive
- **AND** current views describe only the canonical specs on disk

scenarios.name: Diagram generation fails after native success
scenarios.text:
#### Scenario: Diagram generation fails after native success
- **WHEN** the original operation succeeds but its diagram refresh fails
- **THEN** the wrapper reports both outcomes and the documentation scope to repair
- **AND** it does not repeat the completed native operation

requirements.text:
### Requirement: Respect current and historical scope
The suite SHALL keep proposed, current and archived views distinct and report native-operation and diagram outcomes separately.

#### Scenario: Archive without synchronization
- **WHEN** the original operation archives a change without syncing its specs
- **THEN** the proposed view remains historical in the archive
- **AND** current views describe only the canonical specs on disk

#### Scenario: Diagram generation fails after native success
- **WHEN** the original operation succeeds but its diagram refresh fails
- **THEN** the wrapper reports both outcomes and the documentation scope to repair
- **AND** it does not repeat the completed native operation
